evidence_items.explanation: The study documents training on web text, books and Wikipedia, alongside controlled assessments of generated articles. Together these support learned language patterns as the basis of structured output, without establishing literal cut-and-paste generation.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not establish a literal paraphrase-and-paste mechanism or identify the source of every generated fragment.
The cited generation experiment does not isolate training-data effects with an otherwise identical untrained control.
